name: LUDO
title: Ludo
blurb: Roll a 6 to leave the yard, race your four tokens home, send rivals back. 4- or 6-player board, teams too.
description: Classic Ludo: a 6 to leave the yard and a 6 rolls again, three 6s lose the turn, land on a token to send it home, stars are safe, an exact roll to go home. A 4-player board and a 6-player board, free-for-all or in teams. Two to six players; bots fill seats if you want them.
author: lokeshmohanty
